raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-18 the payments source sends amount corrections in the daily delivery as repeated txn_id rows with record_version incremented (27 v2 rows). silver_transactions keeps every version, so 25 POSTED txn_ids are duplicated and gold totals double-count them. The fix keeps only the latest version of each txn_id, then applies the POSTED filter, so a later version's status overrides the original.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
